description: Recommend a size for a motorcycle jacket, pants, boots, helmet or gloves from a given brand, using only Yardstick's published fit data (Alpinestars, Dainese, Klim, REV'IT!, Shoei, Gaerne). Uncovered brands/items return a plain "not covered" answer and the how-to-measure guide; it never invents sizing. Uses chest (jacket), waist (pants), head circumference (helmet), hand circumference (gloves) or foot length (boots).

product_name.description: Exact model, e.g. Klim Krios Pro or Bell MX-9 Adventure (needed for per-model helmet charts)

units.description: Units for all measurements (default: guessed from values)

name: size_recommendation
title: Motorcycle gear size recommendation
